subject: Recap + shortlist: pick one next step for AtlasApps pilot
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@atlasapps.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + shortlist: pick one next step for AtlasApps pilot

Alex — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our 30m call and three simple options to pick from so we can move forward without back-and-forth.

Key takeaways
- AtlasApps is primarily trying to reduce support LTV by surfacing contextual suggestions inside your support UI (Zendesk).
- Preferred model constraints: sub-250 token completions, deterministic rollout, and ability to pin model versions for compliance.
- Success metric: reduce average handle time by 18–25% for tier-1 tickets in the first 4 weeks.

Proposed pilot scope (what we demo'd):
- 4-week pilot: integration with one support queue, up to 2M tokens/mo, monitoring + weekly checkpoints.
- Includes Redwood's prefix caching and a short quantization profile we recommend for latency.

Please choose one of the three next-step options below (pick A, B, or C):
A) Pilot now — start integration next week; I'll put a technical checklist + timeline together (fastest to validation).
B) Tech-only POC — 1 week: we validate ingestion, latency, and KV cache behavior with a synthetic subset (lower commitment).
C) Pause & reopen in Q3 — you want space while procurement finishes; we'll circle back the first week of July.

If you pick A or B I'll send a brief SOW and a ballpark pricing estimate (no legal yet). If you want a pricing number now, tell me your expected monthly tokens and target latency and I can give a range.

Attachments: 2025-04-11-AtlasApps-discovery-recap.pdf (recap + checklist)
Links: HubSpot deal DL-20250411-ATLAS (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/record/DL-20250411-ATLAS)

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

- Tech-only POC (synthetic dataset, 1-week): $1,200 – $2,000 (engineering time + small token usage).
